name: 31 · Question forms · Normal
description: 50 preguntas normales sobre preguntas directas e indirectas, inversión, auxiliares y formulaciones útiles en reuniones.

questions.question: Choose the correct question.
options: Does this alert affect any production systems?
Does this alert affects any production systems?
This alert does affect any production systems?
Do this alert affect any production systems?
questions.explanation: En present simple, las preguntas con tercera persona usan does + sujeto + verbo base.
questions.translation: ¿Afecta esta alerta a algún sistema de producción?

questions.question: Ask about the time of the first failed sign-in.
options: When occurred the first failed sign-in?
When did the first failed sign-in occur?
When did occur the first failed sign-in?
When the first failed sign-in did occur?
questions.explanation: En past simple usamos did + sujeto + verbo base: did ... occur.
questions.translation: ¿Cuándo se produjo el primer inicio de sesión fallido?

questions.question: Choose the grammatically correct question.
options: Why the endpoint is still isolated?
Why does the endpoint still isolated?
Why is the endpoint still isolated?
Why is still isolated the endpoint?
questions.explanation: Con be, el verbo se invierte con el sujeto: Why is the endpoint...?
questions.translation: ¿Por qué sigue aislado el endpoint?

questions.question: Ask whether the customer has received the report.
options: Did the customer has received the report?
Has received the customer the report?
Does the customer have received the report?
Has the customer received the report?
questions.explanation: El present perfect interrogativo se forma con has/have + sujeto + participio.
questions.translation: ¿Ha recibido el cliente el informe?

questions.question: Choose the correct question about ability.
options: Can the user access the portal now?
Does the user can access the portal now?
Can access the user the portal now?
Can the user accesses the portal now?
questions.explanation: Con un modal, invertimos modal y sujeto y usamos el verbo base: Can the user access...?
questions.translation: ¿Puede el usuario acceder al portal ahora?

questions.question: Choose the correct present continuous question.
options: Do the analysts reviewing the new evidence?
Are the analysts reviewing the new evidence?
Are reviewing the analysts the new evidence?
The analysts are reviewing the new evidence?
questions.explanation: El present continuous interrogativo usa be + sujeto + verbo en -ing.
questions.translation: ¿Están revisando los analistas las nuevas pruebas?

questions.question: Ask whether the rule was changed during the maintenance window.
options: Did the rule was changed during the maintenance window?
Was changed the rule during the maintenance window?
Was the rule changed during the maintenance window?
Did the rule changed during the maintenance window?
questions.explanation: La pasiva con be forma la pregunta invirtiendo was y el sujeto.
questions.translation: ¿Se cambió la regla durante la ventana de mantenimiento?

questions.question: Choose the correct question with there.
options: Does there be any evidence of lateral movement?
There is any evidence of lateral movement?
Is any evidence there of lateral movement?
Is there any evidence of lateral movement?
questions.explanation: Con there is, la pregunta se forma como Is there...?
questions.translation: ¿Hay alguna prueba de movimiento lateral?

questions.question: Ask about a future plan.
options: Will the team rotate the keys tonight?
Does the team will rotate the keys tonight?
Will rotate the team the keys tonight?
Will the team rotates the keys tonight?
questions.explanation: Con will, usamos will + sujeto + verbo base.
questions.translation: ¿Rotará el equipo las claves esta noche?

questions.question: Choose the correct past continuous question.
options: Did the servers running normally before the outage?
Were the servers running normally before the outage?
Were running the servers normally before the outage?
Was the servers running normally before the outage?
questions.explanation: El past continuous interrogativo usa was/were + sujeto + -ing; servers exige were.
questions.translation: ¿Funcionaban los servidores con normalidad antes de la interrupción?

questions.question: You want to know the person who approved the emergency change. Choose the correct question.
options: Who did approved the emergency change?
Who did the emergency change approve?
Who approved the emergency change?
Who was approve the emergency change?
questions.explanation: Cuando who es el sujeto, no usamos do/does/did: Who approved...?
questions.translation: ¿Quién aprobó el cambio de emergencia?

questions.question: You know the analyst contacted someone. Ask about that person.
options: Who contacted the analyst?
Who the analyst contacted?
Who did contact the analyst?
Who did the analyst contact?
questions.explanation: Cuando who es el objeto, usamos did + sujeto + verbo base.
questions.translation: ¿Con quién contactó el analista?

questions.question: Ask which file caused the detection.
options: Which file triggered the detection?
Which file did triggered the detection?
Which did file trigger the detection?
Which file was trigger the detection?
questions.explanation: Which file funciona como sujeto, por lo que no necesita did.
questions.translation: ¿Qué archivo activó la detección?

questions.question: Ask about the object that the attacker downloaded.
options: What downloaded the attacker?
What did the attacker download?
What did the attacker downloaded?
What the attacker did download?
questions.explanation: What es el objeto; usamos did + sujeto + verbo base.
questions.translation: ¿Qué descargó el atacante?

questions.question: Ask about the number of affected accounts.
options: How many accounts did affect?
How much accounts were affected?
How many accounts were affected?
How many were affected accounts?
questions.explanation: How many se usa con nombres contables plurales; la pasiva es were affected.
questions.translation: ¿Cuántas cuentas se vieron afectadas?

questions.question: Ask about the duration of the outage.
options: How long lasted the outage?
How much time did the outage lasted?
How long the outage did last?
How long did the outage last?
questions.explanation: How long pregunta por duración; tras did usamos last en forma base.
questions.translation: ¿Cuánto duró la interrupción?

questions.question: Ask about the team responsible for the firewall change.
options: Which team made the firewall change?
Which team did made the firewall change?
Which did team make the firewall change?
Which team was made the firewall change?
questions.explanation: Which team es el sujeto de made, así que no lleva auxiliar did.
questions.translation: ¿Qué equipo realizó el cambio del cortafuegos?

questions.question: Ask why the customer rejected the recommendation.
options: Why the customer rejected the recommendation?
Why did the customer reject the recommendation?
Why did the customer rejected the recommendation?
Why was the customer reject the recommendation?
questions.explanation: En past simple, why va seguido de did + sujeto + verbo base.
questions.translation: ¿Por qué rechazó el cliente la recomendación?

questions.question: Ask about the owner of an exposed API key.
options: Who API key was exposed?
Whose was exposed API key?
Whose API key was exposed?
Who did own the exposed API key was?
questions.explanation: Whose pregunta por posesión y precede al sustantivo: Whose API key...?
questions.translation: ¿La clave de API de quién quedó expuesta?

questions.question: Ask about the frequency of the backup verification.
options: How often do the backups verified?
How often are verified the backups?
How many often are the backups verified?
How often are the backups verified?
questions.explanation: How often pregunta por frecuencia; la pasiva interrogativa usa are + sujeto + participio.
questions.translation: ¿Con qué frecuencia se verifican las copias de seguridad?

questions.question: Choose the correct indirect question.
options: Could you tell me where the logs are stored?
Could you tell me where are the logs stored?
Could you tell me where do they store the logs?
Could you tell me where the logs stored are?
questions.explanation: Después de la introducción, la pregunta indirecta mantiene orden afirmativo: where the logs are stored.
questions.translation: ¿Podrías decirme dónde se almacenan los registros?

questions.question: Complete the polite request: Do you know ___?
options: has the account been disabled
whether the account has been disabled
whether has been disabled the account
did the account disable
questions.explanation: Una pregunta indirecta de sí/no usa whether/if y orden afirmativo.
questions.translation: ¿Sabes si se ha deshabilitado la cuenta?

questions.question: Choose the correct embedded question.
options: We need to understand why did the connection fail.
We need to understand why failed the connection did.
We need to understand why the connection failed.
We need to understand why does the connection failed.
questions.explanation: Tras understand, la cláusula interrogativa usa orden de enunciado: why the connection failed.
questions.translation: Necesitamos entender por qué falló la conexión.

questions.question: Choose the most natural polite question.
options: Could you explain how does this rule work?
Could you explain how works this rule?
Could you explain how this rule does work?
Could you explain how this rule works?
questions.explanation: En la interrogativa indirecta usamos how + sujeto + verbo, sin inversión.
questions.translation: ¿Podrías explicar cómo funciona esta regla?

questions.question: Complete the sentence: I’m not sure ___.
options: when the maintenance window starts
when does the maintenance window start
when starts the maintenance window does
when is start the maintenance window
questions.explanation: Después de I’m not sure usamos orden afirmativo: when the ... starts.
questions.translation: No estoy segura de cuándo empieza la ventana de mantenimiento.

questions.question: Choose the correct question to request a status update politely.
options: Could you let us know has the scan finished?
Could you let us know whether the scan has finished?
Could you let us know whether has finished the scan?
Could you let us know did the scan finish?
questions.explanation: Whether introduce una pregunta indirecta de sí/no y va seguida de orden afirmativo.
questions.translation: ¿Podrías decirnos si ha terminado el análisis?

questions.question: Complete the sentence: The customer asked ___.
options: what evidence had we collected
what did evidence we collect
what evidence we had collected
what evidence we did collected
questions.explanation: Una pregunta reportada usa orden afirmativo: what evidence we had collected.
questions.translation: El cliente preguntó qué pruebas habíamos recopilado.

questions.question: Choose the correct embedded yes/no question.
options: Can you confirm is the IP address still blocked?
Can you confirm if is still blocked the IP address?
Can you confirm does the IP address still blocked?
Can you confirm if the IP address is still blocked?
questions.explanation: If puede introducir una pregunta indirecta de sí/no; después usamos orden afirmativo.
questions.translation: ¿Puedes confirmar si la dirección IP sigue bloqueada?

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: Nobody knows who changed the policy.
Nobody knows who did changed the policy.
Nobody knows who the policy changed.
Nobody knows who was change the policy.
questions.explanation: Who es el sujeto de la cláusula; no se añade did.
questions.translation: Nadie sabe quién cambió la directiva.

questions.question: Complete the request: Please tell me ___.
options: which systems do need to be restarted?
which systems need to be restarted
which do systems need to be restarted
which systems need they to be restarted
questions.explanation: La pregunta indirecta conserva el orden afirmativo y no lleva signo de interrogación dentro de la frase.
questions.translation: Dime qué sistemas deben reiniciarse.

questions.question: Complete the tag: The account is still active, ___?
options: doesn’t it
is it
isn’t it
wasn’t it
questions.explanation: Una oración afirmativa con is lleva una coletilla negativa con el mismo auxiliar: isn’t it?
questions.translation: La cuenta sigue activa, ¿verdad?

questions.question: Complete the tag: The analysts didn’t find malware, ___?
options: didn’t they
were they
do they
did they
questions.explanation: Una oración negativa en past simple lleva tag afirmativo con did.
questions.translation: Los analistas no encontraron malware, ¿verdad?

questions.question: Complete the tag: We should notify the customer, ___?
options: shouldn’t we
don’t we
should we
aren’t we
questions.explanation: La coletilla repite el modal should y cambia la polaridad.
questions.translation: Deberíamos avisar al cliente, ¿no?

questions.question: Complete the tag: Nobody changed the rule, ___?
options: didn’t they
did they
was it
do nobody
questions.explanation: Nobody tiene sentido negativo, por lo que el tag es afirmativo; se usa they como pronombre.
questions.translation: Nadie cambió la regla, ¿verdad?

questions.question: Choose the natural negative question expressing surprise.
options: Doesn’t the team has finished the review yet?
Has the team not finished yet the review?
Hasn’t the team finished the review yet?
Didn’t the team finished the review yet?
questions.explanation: El present perfect negativo interrogativo usa hasn’t + sujeto + participio.
questions.translation: ¿Todavía no ha terminado el equipo la revisión?

questions.question: Complete the tag: There were no failed sign-ins, ___?
options: weren’t there
were they
did there
were there
questions.explanation: Con there were y una idea negativa, la coletilla afirmativa es were there?
questions.translation: No hubo inicios de sesión fallidos, ¿verdad?

questions.question: Choose the correct negative question.
options: Why wasn’t the alert escalated earlier?
Why didn’t the alert was escalated earlier?
Why the alert wasn’t escalated earlier?
Why wasn’t escalated the alert earlier?
questions.explanation: En una pasiva negativa, invertimos wasn’t y el sujeto.
questions.translation: ¿Por qué no se escaló antes la alerta?

questions.question: Complete the tag: Let’s review the timeline, ___?
options: will we
shall we
do we
shouldn’t us
questions.explanation: La coletilla habitual después de Let’s es shall we?
questions.translation: Revisemos la cronología, ¿de acuerdo?

questions.question: Complete the tag: Close the ticket after the call, ___?
options: do you
won’t it
will you
shall we
questions.explanation: Los imperativos suelen llevar will you? como coletilla neutral.
questions.translation: Cierra el ticket después de la llamada, ¿de acuerdo?

questions.question: Choose the correct question when you expect confirmation.
options: The service is back online, doesn’t it?
Isn’t the service back online, is it?
The service back online, isn’t it?
The service is back online, isn’t it?
questions.explanation: La oración principal usa is y es afirmativa; el tag correspondiente es isn’t it?
questions.translation: El servicio vuelve a estar operativo, ¿verdad?

questions.question: Choose the most natural way to ask for clarification in a meeting.
options: Could you clarify what you mean by “confirmed activity”?
Could you clarify what do you mean by “confirmed activity”?
Could you clarify what are you meaning with “confirmed activity”?
Could you clarify what means “confirmed activity” by you?
questions.explanation: Tras clarify, la interrogativa indirecta lleva orden afirmativo: what you mean.
questions.translation: ¿Podrías aclarar qué quieres decir con «actividad confirmada»?

questions.question: Ask politely for permission to add a point.
options: May I to add something to that?
May I add something to that?
Do I may add something to that?
Am I may add something to that?
questions.explanation: May + sujeto + verbo base forma una petición formal de permiso.
questions.translation: ¿Puedo añadir algo a eso?

questions.question: Choose the best question for checking shared understanding.
options: Do we aligned on the next steps?
Are aligned we on the next steps?
Are we aligned on the next steps?
We are aligned on the next steps?
questions.explanation: Con el adjetivo aligned usamos be e inversión: Are we aligned...?
questions.translation: ¿Estamos de acuerdo sobre los siguientes pasos?

questions.question: Ask the customer to repeat a date politely.
options: Could you to repeat the date, please?
Do you could repeat the date, please?
Could repeat you the date, please?
Could you repeat the date, please?
questions.explanation: Could you + verbo base es una estructura cortés y correcta.
questions.translation: ¿Podrías repetir la fecha, por favor?

questions.question: Choose the natural question for exploring an alternative.
options: What would happen if we delayed the change?
What will happen if we would delay the change?
What would happened if we delayed the change?
What did happen if we would delay the change?
questions.explanation: Una hipótesis usa would en la principal y past simple en la cláusula con if.
questions.translation: ¿Qué ocurriría si retrasáramos el cambio?

questions.question: Ask about the person responsible for an action item.
options: Who does will take ownership of this action?
Who will take ownership of this action?
Who will takes ownership of this action?
Who will this action take ownership of?
questions.explanation: Who es sujeto y con will se usa el verbo base: will take.
questions.translation: ¿Quién se responsabilizará de esta acción?

questions.question: Choose the most natural way to verify a deadline.
options: When are you need the final report?
When you do need the final report?
When do you need the final report?
When does you need the final report?
questions.explanation: En present simple con you usamos do + sujeto + verbo base.
questions.translation: ¿Cuándo necesitas el informe final?

questions.question: Ask politely whether screen sharing is possible.
options: Would you mind to share your screen?
Do you mind to sharing your screen?
Would you mind share your screen?
Would you mind sharing your screen?
questions.explanation: Would you mind va seguido de gerundio.
questions.translation: ¿Te importaría compartir la pantalla?

questions.question: Choose the best follow-up question after an unclear answer.
options: Could you give us an example?
Could you give to us an example?
Could you to give us an example?
Do you could give us an example?
questions.explanation: Could you + verbo base forma una petición cortés; give someone something no requiere to.
questions.translation: ¿Podrías darnos un ejemplo?

questions.question: Ask for confirmation of the agreed scope.
options: Did we agreed which systems are in scope?
Have we agreed which systems are in scope?
Have agreed we which systems are in scope?
Do we have agree which systems are in scope?
questions.explanation: El present perfect interrogativo usa have + sujeto + participio: Have we agreed...?
questions.translation: ¿Hemos acordado qué sistemas están incluidos en el alcance?
